source_title: 'We have not authorized any official fan club': Jason Sanjay issues warning over fake accounts; shares of - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Jason Sanjay, filmmaker and son of Tamil Nadu CM Vijay, has issued a public clarification about fake social media accounts operating in his name. He has identified his authorized Instagram, Facebook and X profiles, asking followers to avoid relying on other accounts claiming to represent him. The filmmaker has also made it clear that no official fan club or community has been approved by him or his team.Jason Sanjay identifies his official social media accountsJason shared the details of his authorized profiles and urged followers to use them when looking for updates about him. In his social media post, he wrote, "My only official accounts are Instagram - jason.sanjay_official , Facebook - JasonSanjay , and X - @official_jsj â Jason Sanjay."'Sigma' director warns against fake profiles using his identityThe statement explains that Jason has not authorized any additional accounts on these platforms or elsewhere. It also cautions users against believing profiles that use his name, photographs or other identifying details.The declaration reads, "I am here by writing to formally inform my official, authorized social media identities. Please be advised that the accounts listed below are the only profiles managed, owned, or authorized by me:"It further states, "Any other accounts, pages, or profiles operating under my name, likeness, or variations of my identity on these or any other digital platforms are entirely fake."Jason Sanjay distances himself from unauthorized messagesJason has also clarified that he cannot be held responsible for activities carried out through accounts that are not included in his official list. This covers posts, comments, private messages and business-related communications.The declaration specifically states, "Consequently, any posts, comments, direct messages, business solicitations, or communications originating from any accounts not explicitly listed above are not mine. I hold no responsibility or liability for their content, actions, or consequences."No official fan club or community has been approvedThe filmmaker has separately addressed online groups that claim to be his official fan clubs. According to the declaration, neither Jason nor his team has launched, recognized or authorized any such organization.The statement reads, "Please be informed that we have not authorized, launched, or recognized any official fan club, association, or community group. Any groups, pages, or accounts claiming to be our "official fan club" or "authorized community" are completely unofficial and unapproved."The clarification comes as Jason takes his first steps as a filmmaker in the Tamil film industry. He recently made his directorial debut with 'Sigma', a heist action-comedy starring Sundeep Kishan and Faria Abdullah in the lead roles.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
